_readme: DEHARDCODE 2026-10-30 — integrity lock for data records that SCP reads at runtime instead of code strings. A record whose canonical hash does not match is NOT used (fail-closed). Changing a record requires updating this lock in the same reviewed change.
hash_method: sha256(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8')) — canonical JSON, independent of EOL/whitespace
